answers.description: An MCP server giving Claude read-only access to a Nightscout instance: glucose readings, treatments, and deterministic server-side aggregates (mean, TIR, CV, GMI).
answers.stack: TypeScript on the official MCP SDK (@modelcontextprotocol/sdk), Node runtime, stdio transport only

intent.goal: Give an AI assistant read-only access to a personal Nightscout instance so its owner can discuss their own glucose data with it, without ever handing that assistant the ability to alter the instance. Roughly ten read tools and four hand-verifiable aggregates (mean, TIR, CV, GMI), computed server-side and deterministically.
intent.users: The instance owner (solo: operator, data subject and developer are the same person). Anyone with write access to the instance (uploaders, phone apps, third-party integrations) is in the threat model rather than the audience.
constraints: stdio local transport only - no HTTP, no listening port (closed decision, ADR required to reopen)
Read-only - never writes to a Nightscout instance (closed decision, ADR required to reopen)
Pinned dependencies and a committed lockfile
Sanitized exceptions - re-throw with the path only, never the URL, which carries the token
Two-level log scrubbing, by value and by pattern, applied where the traceback is rendered
Every identifier interpolated into a URL is validated (Mongo ObjectId)
Free-text fields neutralized before entering tool results
NIGHTSCOUT_URL must be https:// - refuse to start otherwise
TypeScript on the official MCP SDK, on the Node runtime the MCP host spawns
Hard blocker: no Nightscout instance exists yet, and Nightscout does not backfill
Disclosure constraint: audit findings are undisclosed; intakes/ stays gitignored and tracked docs carry abstract rules only
nonGoals: Any write tool, including opt-in, flagged, or forward-compatible ones
HTTP or remote transport, and the auth/rate-limiting layers it would require
Advanced clinical analytics (GRI, LBGI/HBGI, AGP, TIR with confidence intervals)
Being a Nightscout replacement rather than a client
acceptanceCriteria: Refuses to start on a non-https URL and on an admin-secret credential
A real upstream HTTP failure leaks the token nowhere: not in the message, the rendered traceback, or on disk
An identifier that is not a valid Mongo ObjectId is rejected before any URL is built
A treatment carrying hostile text in notes reaches the model neutralized, with the handling documented
Mean, TIR, CV and GMI match Nightscout's own report over the same window, verified by hand
Requested volume is capped server-side and date ranges bounded, regardless of what the model asks
Runs over stdio from a stock MCP host with no listening port opened
